values.note: Showers and flush toilets seasonal; the dump station is at the horse camp, for registered campers only. Campground water lines are shut off for the winter; year-round water at the park office spigot and the chalet.

note: Main campground strung along a road in the wooded Fort Ridgely Creek valley below the park office, with 15 electric sites; a separate horse camp and a tent-only group camp elsewhere in the park. Cell and satellite service is very poor; Wi-Fi at the ranger station. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page + park map + ReserveMN grid: 33 drive-in sites (15 electric; 30-65 ft), 60-ft max RV, showers/flush/vault/water, dump at the horse camp; season 04-02..10-31 from the ReserveMN calendar. The old note placed the campground on the upland prairie; it is in the creek valley. Fees left as the 2026-10-12 rates pass wrote them.
flags: Pin: stored 44.45160,-94.73000 sits on the upland near the Historic Fort Site (picnic loops), not the campground. The DNR map's Main Campground inset puts every site along the road beside Fort Ridgely Creek in the valley to the east; ReserveMN's facility 825 coordinate 44.45396,-94.72638 (~390 m NE of the stored pin) lands on that campground road among the site spurs on imagery. Recommend moving the pin to 44.45396,-94.72638.

waterfront_evidence is wrong and should be rewritten (apply.py does not write it): it reads 'upland-prairie campground, no water nearby', but the campground is in the Fort Ridgely Creek valley. On the DNR map the east-side spurs (18, 19e, 21e, 23e, 25e host, 29e, 31e, 33, 35, 37) point toward the creek, which runs a short way east of the road. The sites are under full canopy on imagery, so open ground to the water cannot be confirmed: recommend keeping 'not waterfront' (a creekside upgrade would need those site numbers placed with open ground to the creek).
Horse camp (ReserveMN facility 762, 13 equestrian sites at 44.47161,-94.73267, 2 km north) and the tent-only group camp are not split candidates (equestrian-only / group-only).

Park notices (agency wording): 'Cell phone and satellite service in both campgrounds is very poor. Wi-Fi is available at the ranger station.' 'An archeological survey will be taking place in both campgrounds at some point in 2027.' 'ATVs are NOT allowed on park roads or trails.' No road or RV-access warning.
